name: Hercai
description: Miran is seeking revenge for his parents death so he plans to marry daughter Reyyan from the family who were responsible for that. Unexpectedly he falls in love with Reyyan. Will this change the plan?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Miran Aslanbey, who came to Midyat as a businessman from Istanbul, offered Nasuh Sadoglu more than a partnership. Miran asks Nasuh's grandson Reyyan to be his wife. However, Nasuh, the most powerful family head in the region, has different plans for Miran, which he calls a very good fortune. He's going to give her a grandchild, but not what he wanted. Nasuh is unaware of Miran's plans. While the decision to be given between the two men is expected curiously, the news will deeply affect the lives of Reyyan and Yaren.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Miran's revenge plan, which he prepared during his life, is about to reach the end. But the surprises of life are waiting for him at the door. He was raised by feeding a grudge and hatred towards the Sadoglu family. As he spends time with Reyyan, he begins to feel different emotions. Azize Aslanbey, who is aware of everything, has different plans against this situation. Azat, who cannot stand any more than all of this, does his best to make Reyyan stop. Azat, who is willing to stand against the world in order to prevent any damage to Reyyan's hair, causes a great ...

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The marriage, which was built with the fire of revenge between Miran and Reyyan, ended as planned by the Aslanbey family. Miran left Reyyan the next day. Unable to bear the pain, Reyyan burned the hut in which she spent her first night with Miran. Miran goes to his mother's grave to let his news of vengeance. Miran who heard the news of the burning hut from Firat, will he leave Reyyan, who is not guilty in this war of revenge?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The mansions of Sadoglu and Aslanbey are on a thorn. The news that Reyyan and Miran jumped into the river shakes all of Mardin people. Now everyone wonders if Miran and Reyyan are dead. Hazar is determined to find Reyyan. Miran, who jumped into the river from behind Reyyan without blinking, manages to save Reyyan. Now it's time to find a secluded and safe place where the two can stay together. Miran's only request is to protect Reyyan. But there is something that he does not know; Reyyan does not want to stay in the same house nor to see Miran's face after all these ...

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The Aslanbey family is shocked when Miran brings Reyyan to his mansion. When does Reyyan, who has been having a hard time at the mansion, will reach happiness? What will be the reaction of Azize Aslanbey in the face of this incident all Midyat heard of? Gönül, who living with Miran's dream, will be able to handle this much? Zehra Sadoglu, who wants to save her only daughter from the hands of Miran, prints the house of Aslanbey. Yaren blames Reyyan for everything she lost. How will Yaren lead threats against Miran Aslanbey? Who is the target of Yaren who doesn't want ...

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After Gül's exit from the hospital, Miran secretly takes Reyyan to the mansion. Gül, who misses her sister, is surprised to see Reyyan. Gül and Reyyan meet for the first time after their long separation. Yaren Sadoglu is in pursuit of new plans. Azize Aslanbey, who plans to protect Elif, loses the confidence of her grandson. Elif hears Aslanbey family what they were doing to Reyyan. She does not remain silent against those in the mansion. Elif, who is shocked by the facts she learns every day, how long will she endure this? Azize Aslanbey will continue to lose loved ...

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Reyyan learns that Miran is married, and she accepts Azat's offer. On the one hand, trying to deal with the fact that Miran is a wedded wife, is Reyyan going under Azat's wings? Azat keeps the hand of Reyyan in front of the entire Sadoglu family. Azat's sentences create an earthquake effect in Sadoglu Mansion. Miran can't decide what to do. What are the current plans of Gonul, who believes that Miran will return to her after all this? What will Sultan do when she hears Gonul's plans?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Miran Aslanbey who tries all the way to save Reyyan, collapsed with Reyyan's saying, "The one who's here stays here." After Reyyan accepts a marriage proposal from Azat, things get mixed up in two mansions. In all this mess, Miran's path intersects little Gül. There are also tense moments in Sadoglu Mansion. On the one hand there is Azad who stands against his grandfather Nasuh Sadoglu. On the other hand, Yaren chasing games again. And Miran, who grows up to take revenge, whirls between his heart and mind, turning his gun into Reyyan's father.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Reyyan goes to Melike's village in order to move away from her experiences and make the right decision, but Miran finds Reyyan there. Miran tries to persuade Reyyan to trust him again. Azat, destroyed by Reyyan's departure, has no intention of giving up immediately. Azat, who cannot accept what Reyyan said, takes action. On the other hand, Yaren, who was caught by her father while she was working with the enemy, waiting a big surprise. Cihan, who learns his daughter's actions and has no more patience, is furious.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: After the move made by Azize Aslanbey to buy the Sadoglu mansion, Miran went to Nasuh Aga with his offer. The result of the showdown between Miran and Nasuh will once again change the balance between the two mansions. How will Reyyan respond to Miran's offer? On the other hand, the plans of Gönül who does not want to lose Miran are revealed. Miran decides to divorce. This causes a second earthquake in the Aslanbey mansion. How will Azize and Sultan move against this situation?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Miran asks for a second chance from Reyyan. Reyyan, who does not trust Miran, has remained in the midst of her heart and mind. Miran kidnaps Reyyan and Azat gets angry. Azat in turn abducts Gonul. He says if they don't bring Reyyan back, he won't release Gonul. Azat's move brings two families face to face.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Miran wants Reyyan for twenty-four hours in order to explain all the events and to gain her trust again. Hazar, who eventually learns about Reyyan's place and wants to take his daughter, faces Miran once again. Reyyan learns that Azat has kidnapped Gonul. She makes the right decision to prevent any harm. Gonul does her last move in order not to lose control when she encounters an unexpected situation.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Miran proposes marriage to Reyyan. What will his answer be to Reyyan's question? Will he be able to give up the revenge whispered in his ear since childhood for the sake of his love? Or will the hatred in his heart prevail over his love? And what about Reyyan? Will she be able to forget the past and believe in miracles again? Or will the pain woven into her heart surface and drive her away from Miran? Azize, who drove the Şadoğlu family from their home, is determined to open the doors of the past! The truth sleeping behind 27 years of revenge is slowly coming to light. Will what happened between Nasuh and Azize in the past start a new war today? Can Reyyan and Miran's love stop this war?

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Despite Hazar's fight to protect his daughter, Reyyan's decision to marry comes as a shock to the Şadoğlu family. Hazar, who says, "I accept my daughter as my adopted daughter," refuses to believe Reyyan's decision. While the whole family has written Reyyan off, Zehra and Hazar once again take action for her. On the other hand, Miran's decision to marry causes Azize's 27-year-long plan for revenge to change. Will these events open the doors to a new war between the two families, or will an unexpected decision shift everything? Will Miran and Reyyan be able to reach a happy ending despite the obstacles they face?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Azize Aslanbey, vowing to use this love as a pretext for revenge, orchestrates a scheme that brings Miran and Reyyan back to the Aslanbey mansion, hoping for a fresh start. Despite everything going according to plan, will Azize Aslanbey truly win this game? Miran, repeatedly targeted by attacks, despite his grandmother's pressure, refuses to confront the Şadoğlu family, keeping his promise to Reyyan. This change in Miran strengthens Reyyan's belief that they will overcome all obstacles in their fight for their love. Meanwhile, Hazar, unwilling to see Reyyan stay at the Aslanbey mansion, begins investigating the attacks on Miran to uncover the truth. This move by Hazar jeopardizes Azize's plans.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Azize Aslanbey, vowing to use this love as a pretext for revenge, orchestrates a scheme that brings Miran and Reyyan back to the Aslanbey mansion, hoping for a fresh start. Despite everything going according to plan, will Azize Aslanbey truly win this game? Miran, repeatedly targeted by attacks, despite his grandmother's pressure, refuses to confront the Şadoğlu family, keeping his promise to Reyyan. This change in Miran strengthens Reyyan's belief that they will overcome all obstacles in their fight for their love. Meanwhile, Hazar, unwilling to see Reyyan stay at the Aslanbey mansion, begins investigating the attacks on Miran to uncover the truth. This move by Hazar jeopardizes Azize's plans.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Reyyan and Miran, who begin to heal the wounds in their hearts caused by the regrets of the past, continue to fight on their path to strengthen their bond and prove their love to everyone, despite all the bad events that have happened. In this endeavor, Miran takes action to atone for the mistake his grandmother made to Reyyan long ago. Meanwhile, Hazar, trying to prove that there is another enemy and that the Şadoğlu family is innocent of what happened, decides to talk to an old acquaintance to prove that what Miran knows about the past is untrue. Will this person, a witness to the past events, extend a helping hand to Hazar Şadoğlu to prove his innocence?

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Azize, resentful that Reyyan returned to the square where she was thrown out in her wedding dress, this time as Miran Aslanbey's wife, told Miran that Reyyan married him for her and Azat's lives, and was put in a difficult position when Reyyan mentioned the note. While these events strengthen Reyyan and Miran's love and trust for each other, Azize's answer to Miran's question will change the fate of what happens next. Truths that no one dared to speak until now because of Azize Aslanbey begin to surface thanks to Reyyan's courageous move. As the secrets of the past are revealed one by one, a glimmer of hope is born in Reyyan's heart: Miran will learn the truth and give up his revenge! While Reyyan does everything in her power to make Miran abandon his revenge,

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Having always gotten what she wanted through her manipulative games, Azize Aslanbey can no longer resist the love between Miran and Reyyan, and the control she has held over Miran for years begins to crumble. Miran, having uncovered his grandmother's scheme, is shaken by this truth he faces for the first time, while Reyyan, unable to bear watching the man she loves suffer, tries to heal his wounds with her love. Esma, no longer able to stand idly by while Azize turns innocent lives into hell for the sake of revenge, delivers the letter Dilşah entrusted to her to Hazar in order to stop Azize. Believing that she can prove the truth to Miran thanks to the helping hand extended from the past by Dilşah, whom she loved deeply years ago, Hazar wonders if he can win this battle against Azize, convince Miran of his innocence, and get Reyyan out of the Aslanbey mansion.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Hazar, who goes to the Aslanbey mansion to speak with Miran and Reyyan to prove his innocence, encounters an unexpected situation. Reyyan is shocked to see Miran standing over her father, who lies motionless in the courtyard. Reyyan, who has been trying to dissuade Miran from revenge and defending her father's innocence, will have her trust in Miran severely tested by these events. Miran, who has expressed his anger towards Hazar at every opportunity, becomes the target of all suspicion after Hazar's fall. As Miran and Reyyan's love faces its greatest test, is Miran Aslanbey truly the one who attempted to take Hazar Şadoğlu's life as a result of 27 years of pain and anger? Or is it someone else who wants this fairytale love, which grows stronger every day, to be forever incomplete?

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Reyyan, who initially alienated the entire Şadoğlu family, including Zehra, by believing in Miran, is devastated by her mother's slap. Just when she thought she was ready to bear the weight of her love, her mother's reaction deeply wounds her, and she blames herself for what happened to her father. Unable to bear Reyyan's self-blame, Miran tries to comfort her with all his love. Meanwhile, Hazar's recovery from his life-threatening condition and his regaining consciousness bring joy to the Şadoğlu family. Zehra regrets slapping her daughter and wants to know if her reason for hitting Reyyan was justified. Learning that her father has woken up, Reyyan, empowered by Miran's presence, comes to the hospital. While Reyyan rejoices at reuniting with her father, everyone has one question on their minds: Was it really Miran who pushed Hazar Şadoğlu?

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview:
Hazar's naming of Miran changes everything between Reyyan and Miran. While Miran shouts his innocence, Reyyan, certain of the truth of her father's words, believes that Miran has been faking it all this time and hasn't given up on his revenge. Realizing that she can't extinguish the anger within Miran no matter what she does, Reyyan vows to fight to protect her family from now on. The fact that a single word from Hazar could destroy everything deeply wounds Miran, and he feels Reyyan is being unfair to him.

"Miran is the son of Hazar and Dilşah!"

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Upon learning that the letter will prove her father's innocence, Reyyan and Miran set out to uncover the truth. While Miran doesn't believe in the letter's existence, Reyyan is determined to reveal the truth and prove to Miran and the Aslanbey family that everything they've known until now is false. Zehra is on the verge of making a critical decision after learning the truth about Miran and Hazar. Caught between her family and Miran, what will Zehra's decision be? Azize Aslanbey's revenge plan is jeopardized because of the letter, whose existence she has only recently learned about.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Reyyan's search for the truth about the past drags Miran into a pursuit of truths he doesn't believe, but Miran remains by her side as promised. Reyyan, searching for Dilşah's ring, is devastated by an unexpected answer. However, an unseen hand opens the doors to a completely different past for Reyyan and Miran. While chasing after truths he doesn't believe alongside Reyyan, Miran is forced to confront the truth about his mother. What will he do? Meanwhile, Elif, unable to bear Reyyan's refusal to forgive Miran and fearing her grandmother's new schemes, seeks help from Azat. Will she be able to confess the truth and bring Reyyan and Miran back together?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: For Miran, the last straw is Reyyan's untrustworthiness and his belief that Elif is manipulating things despite telling the truth. Hazar's confession changes everything between Reyyan and Miran. While Reyyan tries to make amends with Miran, she also struggles to cope with the disappointment of the lies her family told. Azize loses control when she learns that Elif has gone to the Şadoğlu mansion. The confrontation between the two families at the Şadoğlu mansion forces Azize to make a difficult choice. Meanwhile, Gönül, who believes Miran will not forgive Reyyan, slowly begins to reveal her true face. On the other hand, Reyyan, wanting to show Miran that they are stronger together, finds Miran seeking solace in his mother's past, and the revelation of an unexpected truth changes the course of everything.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: As Reyyan and Miran, who vowed never to part again at the place where it all began, embark on a new chapter, Miran's past also begins to change. Will the reappearance of Şükran, who has buried her pain in her heart for years hoping Miran would one day return, reveal the truth about the past that Azize Aslanbey altered? Meanwhile, at the Şadoğlu mansion, Yaren, whose punishment was decided by Nasuh after her actions were revealed, collaborates with the enemy to escape this punishment. Having lost her reputation at the mansion, will Yaren be able to regain her former immunity with this move? On the other hand, while the silent war continues at the Aslanbey mansion, Azize Aslanbey, seeing Miran distancing himself from her, takes action to regain his lost trust, but Azize is unaware of the even greater storm to come.
